title: Horizon Q content item
description: One item in the content graph. Items NEVER carry coordinates. Worlds derive geometry from the abstract spatial properties below.

id.description: Stable slug. Never regenerate; other items reference it.

type.description: observatory = external standalone tool, linked not absorbed.

poster.description: Path under /public. Lets the world render richly without loading the target.

spatial.description: Abstract properties only. A world maps these to geometry; content must not know whether it is a star or a tower.

magnitude.description: How much this item should dominate. Orbital -> radius+size. Landscape -> building height.

depth.description: 0 = entry-level overview, 1 = deep technical. Drives placement away from the arrival point.

connections.description: IDs of related items. Orbital -> gravitational grouping. Landscape -> street adjacency.

anchor.description: Landmark. Every world must place anchors somewhere immediately visible.

access.description: Reserved. Everything is public today; the build filters on this if that ever changes.

dataLicence.description: Provenance for aggregated third-party data. Recorded now so it never has to be reconstructed.

locked.description: Field names agents must not modify. CI fails any PR that touches one.

liveness.description: Maintained by the liveness agent for observatory items.
